packageRules.description: Automerge patch updates after the required checks pass
Automerge minor updates from 1.0 and later; a 0.x minor can break
Keep language toolchain updates for a human

An ort bump can change ONNX Runtime's execution-provider placement. ort rc.15 put the embedder on CoreML on macOS (~21 GB footprint) until the sessions set PreferCPU. CI does not run the placement guard, so run it before you approve: just verify cargo test -p hallouminate --test it session_device -- --ignored
